components.name: Codec encoder + decoder (autoencoder pretrain)
components.data: Rights-cleared 24 kHz mono 16-bit PCM singing; see docs/DATA_MANIFEST.md
components.note: No GAN loss yet: listen to reconstructions before trusting as teacher.

components.name: HarmoniaSynth head (phonemes+F0 -> codec latent)
components.data: Same recordings plus per-file frame-level features (phon, f0, voiced, loud @120 Hz)

components.name: Forced aligner (phoneme timings)
components.fetch: Install Montreal Forced Aligner (or a singing-aware aligner), align your recordings, then `touch assets/aligner/READY`.
components.note: Not part of this repo. Check the aligner's own model licence.

components.name: F0 tracker weights (RMVPE or CREPE)
components.fetch: Obtain rmvpe.pt from its upstream release and place it at assets/rmvpe/rmvpe.pt.
components.note: Weights licence not verified by the maintainers. Check before any commercial use.

components.name: Causal (streaming) transposed-conv decoder
components.note: CausalTransposedConv1d fails test_streaming_equivalence.py / test_causal_streaming.py (wrong output length, re-emits overlap). Needs a code fix, not training.
